definition: Indigenius AI, formerly CDIAL (Centre for Digitization of Indigenous African Languages), is a Nigerian technology company that develops voice artificial intelligence for African languages.
details: Its systems are used to automate customer service for banks and telecommunications operators, and operate in Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo, among other languages. The company was founded in 2021 in Lagos, Nigeria, and later adopted the name Indigenius AI.
